Class World

java.lang.Object
world.World
All Implemented Interfaces:
Arena
public class World extends Object implements Arena
The world of a level and everything in it: the tunnel, the drops, the enemies, the checkpoints, the lights, the doors and their buttons. It runs the rules of the game each frame and implements Arena so the enemies can move in it and the balls of the player can fly in it. The abilities of the player's drop are the Dash and Shoot objects it holds.

A level fills it through its layout. The player's Progress outlives it: the world is rebuilt at each death.

    • holdDash

      public void holdDash(boolean held)
      Tells the world whether the dash key is held, once a frame before update(double, int, int). While it is held, the back of the player's drop sticks to the ground and its head stretches away like an elastic; letting go throws the drop from its back toward its head. Pulled too far, the drop tears in two, and the key must be let go before the next dash. Nothing happens if the player can't dash.
      Parameters:
      held - whether the dash key is held

    • cancelDash

    • holdSlide

      public void holdSlide(boolean held)
      Tells the world whether the slide key is held, once a frame before update(double, int, int). A press makes the player's drop keep the speed and the direction it has, with no key held and whatever is steered; another press gives the control back. A drop slower than Slide.MIN_SPEED doesn't start, and nothing starts if the player can't slide. Sticking the back of the drop for a dash, taking another drop or hitting an edge of the world ends the slide.
      Parameters:
      held - whether the slide key is held

    • holdShot

      public void holdShot(boolean held, double directionX, double directionY)
      Tells the world whether the shoot key is held and where the player aims, once a frame before update(double, int, int). While the key is held, the shot charges; letting go fires a ball from the player's drop, the stronger the longer the key was held. Held longer than Shoot.CHARGE_TIME, the charge blows the drop up. Nothing charges if the player can't shoot.
      Parameters:
      held - whether the shoot key is held
      directionX - x of the direction aimed at, of any length; 0 with directionY to keep the last one
      directionY - y of the direction aimed at
